title: incident-bot: on-call auto-diagnostics + SLO runbook quicklinks
author: Sofia Park
description: Adds two related features to improve on-call efficiency: 1) automated diagnostics invocation from SLO alerts that surfaces targeted runbooks and pre-run diagnostic checks; 2) contextual quicklinks in the on-call summary that surface runbooks, remediation snippets, and suggested diagnostic commands. Motivation: reduce time-to-diagnosis and mean time to acknowledge for common SLO classes by surfacing runbooks and automated diagnostics upfront. Key behaviors: when an SLO alert is created the incident-bot will call the auto-diagnostics pipeline with the alert context, attach a compact diagnostic summary to the incident, and surface a ranked list of runbook quicklinks tailored to the SLO and service tags; on the on-call summary card quicklinks are shown for the top 3 runbooks and a single-click 'Run diagnostics' button that launches the autodiagnostics workflow and appends results to the incident timeline. This PR includes feature flags (runtime config) for gradual rollout, telemetry for acceptance (metrics and traces), and small docs updates for operators. Backwards compatibility: all behavior is opt-in via flags and does not change existing alert routing. Rollout plan: enable for staging first (10% of alerts), monitor acceptance metrics for 72 hours, then ramp to 100% for teams that opt in. Rollback: flip runtime flag off. Related: ENG-4821 design doc link, ENG-4990 postmortem follow-ups. Tests: unit tests for diagnostics invocation and quicklink ranking, e2e harness simulating SLO alerts, and manual verification steps in the PR checklist. CI: flaked integration test retried once then passed. Merge method: squash and merge.
